La fleur de Cusamar est ingérée pour restaurer 15 à 60 points de vie. La puissance de cette guérison contraste avec l'extrême rareté de la plante dans les landes froides. This flower is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in heaths, scrublands, and moors, and is best known in northern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains almost impossible to find.

The Cusamar flower is swallowed to restore 15–60 concussion hits. The power of this healing contrasts with the plant's extreme rarity in cold moorlands. Finding it may warrant a dedicated expedition when a group seeks exceptional remedies.
